page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head "EPISTOLA" at the top centre; a catchword "Ioseph" at the lower right below the last line. The right edge shows a neighbouring page's show-through and fragmentary marginal text, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: & sacra passim Scriptura nobis testatur: & etiam experientia, recte rem consideremus, uerũ esse demonstrat. Abrahamo namq; & Lotho legimus angelos ante Sodomæ & reliquarũ circumiacentiũ urbium euersionem apparuisse: ut est in Genesi cap 28 & 29. Et habemus inter cætera illustre sanè pulcherrimumq; huius rei testimonium Exodi 4. ubi angelus Domini eo ipso tempore, quo populum Iudaicũ hostiliter persequebatur Pharao, castra Israelitica conspectus est præire. Iosuæ consimili ratione, cum prelium contra hostes ingrederetur, angelus in albeti præcessit equo: qui pro populo Dei strenuè pugnare uisus est. Ita & in Nouo testamento legitur, Iosepho apparuisse in somnis angelum: qui monebat eum, ne Mariam grauidam Spiritus sancti virtute facta deseret. Et cum Herodes, crudelis ille tyrannus, pueri IESV vitæ insidiaretur: angeli solùm commonefactione ab imminẽte periculo Ioseph
main_text.notes: Marginal text on the right edge is cut off and only partly legible (fragments such as "Iosepho", "S. Paro", "Maria"); it is not transcribed. The word "recte" in the line "recte rem" is printed as "ˇectè" with damage. The page has heavy show-through from the facing page.
